# ROUTE_CLAIM

A public hostname this floe publishes, for whoever answers for the zone.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `route`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.route`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| host | DNS name |
